display.purpose: Emotional weight: italic emphasis in headlines, card titles, pull-quote sections, footer brand name. Always italic; never roman on its own.

headline.purpose: Page-level hero H1. Always weight 300. Paired with Spectral italic em for emphasis in Morning Brass.

title.purpose: Section-level H2 headings. Always weight 300. May include Spectral italic em for Island Moss emphasis.

body.purpose: Long-form copy. Weight 300. Hard cap at 65–75ch line length.

label.purpose: Eyebrow labels, nav links, button text, category tags, vertical accordion labels. Always uppercase, always with generous letter-spacing.

shadows.name: nav-ambient
shadows.purpose: Floating pill nav separation from hero content beneath. Fixed — does not change on interaction.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover only. Warm Harbour Brass diffusion confirming the primary action.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Accompanies the 2px Harbour Brass :focus-visible outline on buttons. Glow without noise at rest.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Standard UI interactions: reveals, button hover, nav transitions, dropdown entry.

motion.name: ease-io
motion.purpose: Page curtain transitions only — heavy, emphatic.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Horizontal accordion flex expansion. Mimics iOS drawer feel.

motion.name: hero-ken
motion.purpose: Hero image slow Ken Burns: scale(1.08) to scale(1.0) on page load.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Intersection Observer scroll reveals. Stagger classes: d1=0.12s, d2=0.24s, d3=0.38s, d4=0.52s.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.notes: Mobile accordion collapses to vertical stack; accordion content always visible.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.notes: Nav collapses: pill links hidden, hamburger shown, mobile overlay active.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.notes: Bento grid reflows: main card spans full 12 cols, remaining two split 6/6.

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview:
Not a hotel that impresses — a house that receives. The analogy is physical: walking into a well-loved granite building on the Atlantic edge of the Channel Islands, where the walls are honest, the light is warm, and no one is trying to perform hospitality at you. The design system inherits this quality. Space is used like silence in a good sentence: deliberately, because it earns its emptiness. Warmth comes from material choices — a brass-toned accent, linen-weight neutrals, a serif face that reads like handwriting — not from decoration.

The typographic system pairs Jost (a refined geometric sans, cool but not cold) with Spectral (a screen-optimised classical serif, warm and slightly literary). Jost carries the structural weight: headings, navigation, labels. Spectral carries the emotional weight: italic emphasis, pull quotes, card titles, the scrub quotation. The pairing creates the core brand tension — structured but not corporate, warm but not cosy.

Color is restrained. The cream-and-ink base accounts for the majority of every surface. Harbour Brass appears at decision points: CTAs, active states, eyebrow labels, the scroll indicator. It is never decorative. The Island Moss surface appears once — the CTA section — as a distinct tonal register that signals arrival and action.
keyCharacteristics: Linen-weight neutrals as the ambient surface; ink as deep structure; Harbour Brass as the single voice
Two-family type system: geometric sans for structure, classical serif for emotion
Sharp-cornered components (zero radius on buttons and cards) — confidence, not softness
Section-level spacing is generous and cinematic; components are tight within sections
Motion is choreographed but unhurried: ease-drawer for accordions, ease-out-expo for reveals

rules.name: The Brass Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Harbour Brass appears on ≤10% of any given surface. Guard it: CTAs, labels, and active states only — never as a background fill outside the nav CTA pill.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: Pure #fff and #000 are prohibited. Every neutral is tinted warm toward the brand hue. The coldest white is #FDFCF9; the deepest ink is #1A1A18.

rules.name: The Italic Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Spectral italic is the only permitted emphasis pattern within Jost headlines. When a heading gets an emotional beat, it gets Spectral italic in Morning Brass.

rules.name: The Weight Discipline Rule
rules.body: Display and body headings are weight 300. The system's authority comes from scale and spacing, not weight. Reserve 500–600 for labels and micro-copy only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state or to physically separate a floating element. A card at rest has no shadow.

dos: Do use Spectral italic exclusively for emotional emphasis phrases inside Jost headlines — the em pattern is the brand's typographic handshake.
Do keep Harbour Brass (#B8965A) to ≤10% of any surface. Use it for CTAs, active states, labels, and focus rings only.
Do use sharp corners (0 border radius) on all buttons and content cards.
Do write section spacing generously: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 7rem) or larger. Sections are cinematic chapters.
Do use the bento grid's 3px Night Harbour gap as the visual divider — no extra borders or drop shadows.
Do prefix all focus states with :focus-visible, never :focus. Provide both outline and glow for buttons.
Do guard the prefers-reduced-motion media query for all transitions, animations, GSAP blocks, and scroll effects.
Do use clamp() for all display and title font sizes.
Do tint every neutral toward the brand hue — never pure #fff or #000.
donts: Don't use backdrop-filter or glassmorphism anywhere — not on the nav, not on overlays. The nav uses a solid 97% opacity background.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with gradient). Emphasis is weight, scale, and Spectral italic.
Don't use the hero-metric template: big number + small label in a stats grid. Explicitly prohibited as a SaaS cliché.
Don't place a credentials ticker or auto-scrolling marquee anywhere on the site.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right > 1px as a colored accent).
Don't use generic hotel chain layout conventions: Marriott/Hilton corporate templates, identical icon + heading + text card grids.
Don't drift toward over-designed boutique hotel aesthetics: black-heavy, serif-maximalist, editorial overload.
Don't drift toward quaint British B&B aesthetics: floral patterns, cottage-cosy warmth, dated serif-heavy headlines.
Don't animate CSS layout properties (height, width, padding, margin). Only transform and opacity — GPU only.
Don't use Playfair Display or Outfit. Both are training-data reflexes for luxury boutique hotel UI.
Don't add badge overlays or floating stamp icons onto hero imagery.
